title: 'travel to a known place' is inconsistent: at some hubs it lists every specific room visited in the region (e.g. 10 named rooms from the Oath-Ground), at others it collapses to broad region names only ('toward Wardmoor', 'toward Hollowbrook') even after visiting many specific rooms there, making fast-travel unpredictable. Separately, opening that submenu and then backing out with 'stay here' still consumes a full game turn, same as an actual move.
